transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on finalizing the Ash Harbor callback package for Mara Quill. We've got Studio 4 booked for June 18, 9 AM to 1 PM, with the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. Before I issue the call sheet, I need each of you — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — to review the package and flag any concerns. Who'd like to go first?

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we go further. Yesterday I reviewed the executed streamer casting addendum, and it requires that audition footage be retained for exactly 14 days and accessible only to the named casting team. I haven't entered those terms in the casting tracker yet, but they're binding. This directly affects our recorded auditions for internal review — we need to make sure access is restricted to the named casting team only, and that the 14-day retention window is built into our footage handling plan.
